positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
(Media Intelligence) - Building tools and platform to make multimedia like videos and audios more useful, such as highly accurate transcription in financial domains.
(Multimedia Platforms) - Designing platform that drives usage of large scale of video, images, and audio content used throughout the company in products such as Bloomberg News.
(Data Technologies) - Worked on business rule engine and metric system that is a part of a large data ingestion systems to achieve high quality datasets with measurable timeliness and accuracy.
